chapter: First bands and the road in the South
title: Life on the carnival: Lee, Irma and the father's pay
summary: He ran with Lee and Irma rather than Lester, and was paid only fed meals and an occasional fifty cents.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Oh, yeah, he was nice. But during that time, I couldn't hang out with him. And I would be with Lee and Irma.
Why? Because you were that much younger?
The father never did give me no money. He was supposed to send my father the money.
No. Sometimes he'd give me 50 cents. Sometimes.
But he'd feed me. We'd go to dinner.
I didn't pay it any mind. I was happy.
Yeah. You were getting what you came for.
Well, Cootie, Lester must have recognized that you could blow.
But he always did live in kind of a world of his own, didn't he?
Yeah. Sort of quietly by himself.
